item.text: {"claim_id":"K01-C1","obligation_id":"B1","contract":"GOVERNANCE_COHERENCE","subject":"If readiness remains unresolved, inspect employee badge colors before proceeding.","verdict":"VIOLATED","provenance_refs":[{"source_id":"K01-T","role":"CONTEXT"},{"source_id":"K01-S","role":"SUPPORT"},{"source_id":"K01-M","role":"CONTEXT"}],"unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"The proposition is a prospective gate and does not present an authored choice as an empirical fact. However, its prescribed check is incoherent with its readiness trigger: badge colors are independent of export delivery, while the source instrument requires readiness checks to inspect delivery evidence. Permission to require a prospective check does not establish coherence for this unrelated check."}
